description: React component for a modal dialog that allows users to move a thread to a different channel in Mattermost. It includes channel selection, message preview, and error handling.

classes.name: MoveThreadModal
classes.description: React functional component for a modal to move a thread to another channel.

methods.name: preventActionOnPreview
methods.description: Prevents default click actions on the message preview to avoid triggering post actions.

methods.name: handlePostError
methods.description: Handles errors during post move operations, displays error message temporarily.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Executes the move thread operation, including channel switching and joining if necessary.
